schema.text: Which of these best describe your current work or study situation? If you both study and work, you can choose two answers.
schema.help: We ask this to describe who takes part in the study. Your answer is not linked to your name.

options.text: Not working because of health problems or disability

en.#Which of these best describe your curre: Which of these best describe your current work or study situation? If you both study and work, you can choose two answers.
en.#We ask this to describe who takes part: We ask this to describe who takes part in the study. Your answer is not linked to your name.
en.#Not working because of health problems: Not working because of health problems or disability

it.#Self-employed or freelance (full-time): Lavoro autonomo o libera professione (tempo pieno)
it.#Self-employed or freelance (part-time): Lavoro autonomo o libera professione (tempo parziale)
it.#Homemaker: Persona che si occupa della casa
it.#Unemployed not looking for work: Disoccupato/a non in cerca di lavoro
it.#Which of these best describe your curre: Quali di queste opzioni descrivono meglio la tua attuale situazione di lavoro o di studio? Se studi e lavori, puoi scegliere due risposte.
it.#We ask this to describe who takes part: Lo chiediamo per descrivere chi partecipa allo studio. La tua risposta non è collegata al tuo nome.
it.#Not working because of health problems: Non lavoro per motivi di salute o disabilità

fr.#Unemployed looking for work: Sans emploi et à la recherche d’un emploi
fr.#Unemployed not looking for work: Sans emploi et ne recherchant pas d’emploi
fr.#Which of these best describe your curre: Lesquelles de ces options décrivent le mieux votre situation actuelle de travail ou d’études ? Si vous étudiez et travaillez, vous pouvez choisir deux réponses.
fr.#We ask this to describe who takes part: Nous posons cette question pour décrire qui participe à l’étude. Votre réponse n’est pas liée à votre nom.
fr.#Student (school, university or training: Élève ou étudiant(e) (école, université ou formation)
fr.#Not working because of health problems: Je ne travaille pas pour des raisons de santé ou de handicap

de.#Occasional or on-call work: Gelegentliche Arbeit oder Arbeit auf Abruf
de.#Which of these best describe your curre: Welche dieser Angaben beschreiben Ihre aktuelle Arbeits- oder Ausbildungssituation am besten? Wenn Sie lernen oder studieren und zugleich arbeiten, können Sie zwei Antworten wählen.
de.#We ask this to describe who takes part: Wir fragen dies, um zu beschreiben, wer an der Studie teilnimmt. Ihre Antwort ist nicht mit Ihrem Namen verbunden.
de.#Not working because of health problems: Ich arbeite aus gesundheitlichen Gründen oder wegen einer Behinderung nicht

tr.#Occasional or on-call work: Ara sıra veya çağrı üzerine iş
tr.#Which of these best describe your curre: Şu anki çalışma veya öğrenim durumunuzu en iyi hangileri tanımlar? Hem okuyup hem çalışıyorsanız iki yanıt seçebilirsiniz.
tr.#We ask this to describe who takes part: Bunu, çalışmaya kimlerin katıldığını tanımlamak için soruyoruz. Yanıtınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez.
tr.#Not working because of health problems: Sağlık sorunları veya engellilik nedeniyle çalışmıyorum

fa.#Unemployed not looking for work: بیکار و در حال حاضر جویای کار نیستم
fa.#Which of these best describe your curre: کدام گزینه‌ها وضعیت فعلی کار یا تحصیل شما را بهتر توصیف می‌کنند؟ اگر هم درس می‌خوانید و هم کار می‌کنید، می‌توانید دو پاسخ انتخاب کنید.
fa.#We ask this to describe who takes part: این را می‌پرسیم تا توصیف کنیم چه کسانی در این مطالعه شرکت می‌کنند. پاسخ شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شود.
fa.#Student (school, university or training: دانش‌آموز یا دانشجو (مدرسه، دانشگاه یا دوره آموزشی)
fa.#Not working because of health problems: به دلیل مشکلات سلامتی یا معلولیت کار نمی‌کنم

hu.#Unemployed not looking for work: Munkanélküli vagyok és jelenleg nem keresek munkát
hu.#Which of these best describe your curre: Melyik válaszok írják le legjobban jelenlegi munka- vagy tanulási helyzetét? Ha tanul és dolgozik is, két választ is megjelölhet.
hu.#We ask this to describe who takes part: Azért kérdezzük, hogy leírjuk, kik vesznek részt a vizsgálatban. A válasza nincs összekapcsolva a nevével.
hu.#Student (school, university or training: Tanuló vagy hallgató (iskola, egyetem vagy képzés)
hu.#Not working because of health problems: Egészségügyi okból vagy fogyatékosság miatt nem dolgozom

ar.#Self-employed or freelance (full-time): عمل حر أو لحسابي الخاص (دوام كامل)
ar.#Self-employed or freelance (part-time): عمل حر أو لحسابي الخاص (دوام جزئي)
ar.#Unemployed looking for work: عاطل عن العمل وأبحث عن عمل
ar.#Unemployed not looking for work: عاطل عن العمل ولا أبحث عن عمل حاليًا
ar.#Which of these best describe your curre: أي من هذه الخيارات يصف بشكل أفضل وضعك الحالي في العمل أو الدراسة؟ إذا كنت تدرس وتعمل معًا، يمكنك اختيار إجابتين.
ar.#We ask this to describe who takes part: نسأل عن ذلك لوصف من يشارك في الدراسة. إجابتك غير مرتبطة باسمك.
ar.#Not working because of health problems: لا أعمل بسبب مشكلات صحية أو إعاقة
